deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v3.3.0 -> 3% (ap-south). change_window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Initiated by @chris. Preflight running.

deploy-bot: Preflight summary:
```nchecks: [tokenizer-compat, model-compat, perf-heat]
baseline: ok
classification-drift: +1.7% on 'billing-embed-qa' (small sample)
kv-cache-pressure: nominal
``n
chris: noted the drift. sample set is small but it's a targeted production prompt. nina: +1.7% is large enough to warrant caution. is this a scoring threshold change or semantics?
product-ops: set is narrow (billing flows). only ~0.2% of overall traffic hits it. we'll monitor.
sre-lee: infra telemetry: canary pods show small RSS jitter during startup, but no OOMs. p95 latency +40ms for 2m during warmup.
ops-kate: i'd prefer we hold before any percent increase. can we isolate to a single shard within ap-south?
chris: i'd like to let 3% warm, but freeze any automatic ramp. if drift holds at +1.7% after 10m we rollback and pin.
deploy-bot: Executing traffic shift -> 3%...
```
action: shift_traffic(v3.3.0, 0.03)
status: in_progress
```

product-ops: tagging 'billing-embed-qa' for continuous eval. please dump diffs at +5m and +12m.
sre-lee: running a targeted restart + cache-priming on canary nodes, will report in ~6m.
nina: ML: prepare A/B diff against v3.2.9 for that prompt subset. if it's a threshold tweak we may accept, but need product signoff.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift complete: 3% -> v3.3.0. Canary nodes reporting ready.

product-ops: +5m eval: classification drift still +1.6% on billing set. global traffic metrics unchanged.
sre-lee: after restart, p95 stablized but we saw one 60s spike in CPU steal coincident with a noisy neighbor allocation.
ops-kate: vote=hold. do not increase to 10%. :no_entry_sign: 
chris: hold recorded. no manual or automated ramp to proceed.
product-ops: product votes HOLD until ML either reduces drift or we have an acceptable explanation. scheduling a short rollback blurb in case we need to revert.
nina: rollback/pin snippet ready: `deploy rollback --to v3.2.9 --region ap-south && pin-version v3.2.9 --reason "canary billing-embed drift"`
chris: good. Also prepping a two-line release note: "Paused v3.3.0 rollout in AP-SOUTH due to a targeted classification regression on billing flows; investigating."
deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 3% by operator hold. No auto-rollback triggered.
chris: action items: (1) SRE continue noisy-neighbor mitigation + confirm infra stability, (2) ML run A/B on billing set and share confusion matrix, (3) Product finalize rollback blurb and stakeholder ping. reconvene in 15m.
ops-kate: i'll mark change window as PAUSED in the tracker and notify oncall. :rotating_light:
product-ops: recording decision: STOP/PAUSE at 3% pending root cause. will escalate if no resolution in 30m.
